Administration of Employee Lifecycle Processes \& Policies

  

* Facilitate the timely and quality focused roll out and execution of all employee life cycle processes across business functions in keeping with the HR philosophy
* Ensure consistent understanding, adoption of and adherence to HR policies across functions and verticals

Attrition \& Performance management

description:
Telemarketing Executive Job Profile

**Company:** Petron Thermoplast LLP  
**Department:** Sales \& Marketing  
**Job Title:** Telemarketing Executive  
**Reporting To:** Sales Manager / Director  
**Location:** Office Based  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **Telemarketing Executive** for our company. The main role of this position is to generate business opportunities by calling potential customers, following up on enquiries, introducing our products, and supporting the sales team in converting leads into orders.

The candidate must have good communication skills, confidence in speaking with customers, and the ability to maintain proper follow\-up records. The person should be able to explain our company products professionally and build customer interest through regular calling and follow\-up.

About Our Company

Petron Thermoplast LLP deals in industrial piping systems and related products such as:

* CPVC pipes and fittings
* UPVC pipes and fittings
* PPH pipes and fittings
* PVDF pipes and fittings
* Valves, flanges, and industrial flow control products
* Chemical tanks and industrial thermoplastic solutions

Our customers are from industries like:

* Oil \& Gas
* Chemical
* Water treatment
* Power plant
* Pharma
* Steel
* Industrial projects

Main Responsibilities

The Telemarketing Executive will be responsible for the following work:

1\. Customer Calling

* Call new and existing customers from company database
* Contact industries, contractors, traders, consultants, and project buyers
* Introduce company products and services professionally
* Explain product range and company profile to customers
* Build customer interest and identify requirement

2\. Lead Generation

* Generate new enquiries through cold calling and follow\-up calling
* Identify decision makers and purchase contacts in target companies
* Collect customer details such as company name, contact person, email ID, phone number, industry, and requirement
* Pass qualified leads to sales team for quotation and closing

3\. Follow\-up Work

* Follow up on sent quotations, catalogues, and technical documents
* Take feedback from customers regarding price, delivery, approval, and competitor status
* Remind customers for pending enquiries, approvals, and purchase orders
* Reconnect with old customers and inactive customers to revive business

4\. Database Management

* Update daily call records in CRM, Excel sheet, or company system
* Maintain proper status of every lead such as interested, follow\-up, not interested, budget issue, no response, or order expected
* Keep record of customer discussions and next follow\-up date
* Ensure no enquiry or lead is missed

5\. Coordination with Sales Team

* Share qualified enquiries with internal sales team
* Coordinate with quotation team for offer submission
* Support sales team with follow\-up updates from customer
* Inform management about hot leads and urgent business opportunities

6\. Market Information Collection

* Gather market information from customers regarding current demand, competitor pricing, project requirements, and buying trends
* Identify which industries and products are getting more enquiries
* Share useful customer feedback with management

Daily Duties

The Telemarketing Executive should do the following on a daily basis:

* Make outbound calls to assigned customer list
* Follow up on pending leads and quotations
* Send introduction email or company profile after call if required
* Update call report and lead sheet
* Submit end\-of\-day report with:
* Number of calls made
* Number of connected calls
* Number of interested customers
* Number of follow\-ups done
* Number of new enquiries generated
* Important customer feedback
* Plan for next day

Required Skills

* Good verbal communication skills
* Confidence in speaking with new customers
* Basic English speaking and writing ability
* Good Hindi communication
* Polite and professional talking style
* Strong follow\-up habit
* Ability to handle rejection and continue calling
* Basic computer knowledge
* Knowledge of email, Excel, CRM, and internet search
* Good listening and convincing skills

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in telemarketing, sales calling, lead generation, or customer follow\-up
* Experience in industrial products, piping products, valves, fittings, or B2B sales is preferred
* Graduate or equivalent qualification preferred
* Fresher can also be considered if communication and confidence are good

Performance KPI / Measurement

Performance of Telemarketing Executive can be checked on these points:

* Number of calls made per day
* Number of connected calls
* Number of follow\-ups completed
* Number of new enquiries generated
* Number of qualified leads passed to sales team
* Number of quotations followed up
* Conversion support from enquiry to order
* Accuracy of CRM and reporting
* Customer response quality

Target Expectations

Example target for telemarketing executive:

* 80 to 120 calls per day
* 15 to 25 meaningful conversations per day
* 5 to 10 interested follow\-ups per day
* 2 to 5 new enquiries per week
* Daily report submission without fail

Behavioral Expectations

The employee must:

* Be disciplined and regular in office timing
* Submit daily work proof and calling report
* Maintain professional behavior with customers
* Avoid careless or incomplete follow\-up
* Be serious about targets and business generation
* Work with honesty and responsibility

Job Objective

The main objective of this role is:  
**To generate more enquiries, improve customer follow\-up, support sales conversion, and increase business opportunities for the company through systematic telecalling and telemarketing activities.**

Short Version for Vacancy Post

**Position:** Telemarketing Executive  
**Company:** Petron Thermoplast LLP  
**Role:** Calling customers, generating enquiries, following up quotations, maintaining lead records, and supporting sales team for industrial products like pipes, fittings, valves, and thermoplastic solutions.  
**Skills Required:** Good communication, follow\-up skills, basic English, computer knowledge, confidence in customer handling.  
**Preferred:** Experience in telecalling, B2B sales, or industrial product marketing.

description:
**Role Summary**  

The Senior Advisor – Employee Services (Data Management) role with London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) is an exciting opportunity to be part of a thriving team in a fast\-paced global organization. We as part People Function help grow business through empowering People Leaders and colleagues and enable LSEG to attract and nurture diverse talent, create opportunities for people to grow meaningful careers and operate at their very best. We drive performance by rewarding excellence, develop engagement and provide best in class experience to our colleagues.


Reporting to the Employee Services Lead within People Operations. Responsible for supporting employee Data Management globally across LSEG and will involve day\-to\-day HR data administration for countries and entities in scope. Delivers excellence in HR administration and services, resolve queries and provides information and systems administration support to our colleagues and internal customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for expert assistance in resolving queries that colleagues, HR and PSS team are unable to address. Should have thorough understanding of HR processes, employee life cycle on Workday and procedures via ServiceNow (case management tool), triage/call out cases to relevant knowledge expert groups as needed and ensure all queries are responded accurately and within defined SLAs.
* Provide guidance to People Leaders and colleagues on all aspects of the employee life cycle including on\-boarding, job changes, leave of absence, off\-boarding, HRIS data management, etc.
* Advise people leaders, colleagues and the People Function community on navigation and use of LSEG’s HRIS and importance of self\-service.
* Maintaining accurate employee records and supporting compliance with data protection legislation.
* Work closely with specialty groups such as Global Mobility, Benefits, HRBP to provide support and guidance on the International Assignment/Transfer process, internal transfers, data changes and assist with employee data administration.
* Provide data in response to routine requests from employees or internal / external customers.
* Perform all hire to retire processes for multiple locations including but not limited to candidate onboarding, transfers, data changes, internal hires, compensation changes, leavers, international assignments, secondments, leave of absences, regulated role updates, learning and development, time off, Payroll input, etc.
* Ability to guide internal HR team on HRIS Workday steps in creating job requisitions, new joiner onboarding; including generating employment contracts, initiating background checks and employee life cycle.
* Leverage experience and knowledge to complete complex tasks related to HR systems and processes.
* Upholding confidentiality and integrity in handling sensitive colleague information and situations.
* Perform peer reviews for other colleagues within the team for BAU activities.
* Required to cross\-train on colleagues’ key responsibilities.
* Process lifecycle changes; including changes to roles, compensation, notice periods, probationary period reviews, working arrangement etc.
* Process leavers; including calculating leave, compensation, bonus, notice period, terminating workers in Workday and any other localizations.

* Conduct regular audits to ensure accuracy of the work performed by the team.
* Act as a Knowledge Expert (KE) to support to team in resolving queries and advise on correct procedures to follow.
* Participate in various People Function harmonization/transformation projects and perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to accurately identify bugs/errors so that they could be fixed prior to the launch.

**Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent experience in Human Resource Management.
* 6 – 8 years of prior HR or consultative experience, particularly in areas relating to HR Systems, Data Management
* Excellent attention to detail and process orientation and with excellent follow through and communication skills
* Prior experience with Workday and ServiceNow is essential.
* Good understanding of HR policies and procedures, with experience of providing advice on intricate transactional HR issues to employees and line managers
* Ability to collaborate and work in a team environment, as well as independently while adhering to defined processes and procedures
* Strong analytic, consultative, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to recognize and deal appropriately with sensitive and confidential information
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel
* Ability to be flexible, multitask and rise to the challenge of large volumes of work during peak periods of HR activity and the ability to deal with changing priorities.
* Innovative, client delivery focused problem solver who is solutions oriented

title: People Data Architect (Senior Manager)
description:
**About us:**


LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.


LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in over 60 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.

**Our people:**


People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.


We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning over 60 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

**Role profile**


As a key member of the People Data \& Insights team, you'll lead on designing and evolving our workforce data model and Master Data Management (MDM) architecture. You'll be the product owner for pioneering cloud\-based People data solutions, seamlessly integrating people\-related data into a single, reliable source for fast insight generation. Your work will empower teams across the organisation to make smarter, faster decisions using robust reporting, analytics, and AI\-powered intelligence.


Collaboration is at the core of this role. You'll partner closely with People Engineering, BI experts, and HR leaders to set a bold data strategy, optimise data flows, and drive best\-in\-class governance. With a sharp focus on ethics, privacy, and responsible AI, you'll champion policy and standards, ensuring our people data is secure, compliant, and future\-ready. This is your opportunity to lead the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies in a role that blends creativity, strategic vision, and technical mastery.

**Why is this job important?**


Empower our global workforce through data innovation. As People Data Architect, you'll have a direct impact on shaping data systems that drive innovation and empower business performance. Your work will turn our people data into a trusted foundation for strategic decisions. This role opens doors to continuous learning, global collaboration, and the chance to be at the forefront of data\-driven HR excellence.

**About the team**


You’ll be part of the People Data \& Insights team – a strategic, globally connected function that delivers personalised, data\-driven insights to inform people strategy, enhance workforce capabilities, and support business performance. We combine people research, analytics, and technology to enable decision\-making at scale, with a growing focus on AI\-enabled solutions.


Our work spans cloud\-based master data for real\-time analytics, scalable dashboards embedded in the flow of work, listening at scale to understand colleague sentiment, and advanced analytics that guide programme and workforce decisions – all underpinned by a strong commitment to ethics, privacy, and responsible AI. As part of a distributed team, you’ll gain exposure to implementing a data governance transformation, international collaboration, and continuous learning opportunities.

**What you’ll deliver**

* Architect the Future of People Data: Take the lead in designing, implementing, and evolving our people data model architecture. You'll ensure all workforce data is seamlessly integrated into a single, reliable source of truth, directly empowering People teams and decision\-makers.
* Pioneer Master Data Management: Own the design of master data management (MDM) architecture for people data. Collaborate with key partners to bring your vision to life, developing practical guidelines and standard methodologies that will drive organisational excellence.
* Lead Data Integration \& Innovation: Develop and execute an ambitious roadmap for data collection and integration across the People Function, uniting diverse people\-related data sources into a cohesive and robust system. Your work will be central to delivering a forward\-thinking People Data \& Insights strategy.
* Take Ownership: Serve as the product owner for our people data model and cloud\-based solution. You’ll set priorities, deliver on the roadmap, unlock enhancements, and swiftly resolve challenges, working closely with stakeholders to continuously improve our workforce data ecosystem.
* Drive Collaborative Partnerships: Work at the heart of cross\-functional teams, partnering with People, People Engineering, Finance, Operations and more to craft the strategic vision for people data architecture. Shape requirements, foster strong governance, and co\-create high\-impact data solutions for People Insights, workforce planning, and reporting.
* Steer Data Strategy \& Governance: Be a key player in setting standards for people data assets, partnering with People Engineering to uphold robust governance and standards across our People data landscape.
* Explore \& Innovate: Stay ahead of the curve by monitoring trends in data architecture, AI, and HR technology. Your expertise will guide the evaluation and adoption of new techniques and tools that will elevate our organisation’s data capabilities.
* Safeguard Security \& Compliance: Take ownership of data privacy and security, ensuring all people data products align with regulations (such as GDPR) and our own rigorous standards.
* Champion Data Quality: Collaborate with the People Data Governance Senior Analyst and Master Data Management teams ensure high data quality standards within the cloud\-based data solution.
* Lead Change \& Inspire Communication: Use change management practices to drive successful adoption of data architecture projects. You’ll develop engaging training materials and keep senior leadership and stakeholders informed of progress, improvements, and performance metrics.

**About you**

* Demonstrated experience of delivering business impact by identifying and solving data problems.
* Extensive experience (typically 8\+ years) in data architecture or data modelling, with a specific focus on HR, workforce, or people data in complex organisational environments.
* Expertise in cloud\-based data solutions and ETL processes relevant to HR and workforce analytics.
* Thorough understanding of HR data domains, data governance frameworks, and best practices for managing people data.
* Skilled in stakeholder management, translating HR and workforce business needs into technical requirements and solutions.
* Proficiency with data modelling tools and technologies (such as SQL, Python, and data visualisation platforms) commonly used for HR analytics.
* DCAM (Data Management Capability Assessment Model) or equivalent certification desirable, demonstrating advanced proficiency in data management standards and practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Are you ready to make your mark and shape the data\-driven future of our workforce? If you’re an experienced, innovative, and collaborative data leader, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Program Manager, Schools Program
description:
Published 2026\-04\-08
Location : Bangalore, Karnataka  

  

**About the Program**


The Karnataka Schools Program works to equip adolescents in government secondary schools with **Future Skills** essential for thriving careers. These include Computational Thinking, Foundational Digital Skills, Career Awareness, and AI \& Emerging Technology literacy.


The program focuses on long\-term systems change by Institutionalizing future skills within curriculum frameworks , Strengthening educator capacity through scalable, teacher\-led models, Building strong partnerships with state education bodies, Embedding monitoring and delivery mechanisms within government systems

### **Role Overview**


The **Senior Program Manager – Schools Program** will lead the Karnataka state strategy, oversee high\-quality implementation across districts, and drive deep government partnerships to mainstream future skills education at scale. This role requires strong strategic thinking, government engagement expertise, and the ability to lead complex, multi\-stakeholder programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

### **1\. Strategic Planning, Systems Change \& Program Leadership**

* Anchor and drive the Karnataka state strategy in alignment with organizational priorities and long\-term systems\-change goals.
* Develop annual operational plans with clear milestones, budgets, timelines, and delivery frameworks across program components.
* Lead the development of a 3–5 year state strategy, including resource planning, team structure, and scale pathways.
* Identify and pursue strategic partnerships, advocacy opportunities, and ecosystem collaborations to advance future skills for career readiness.
* Ensure all donor commitments are met, including timely, accurate narrative and data reporting.
* Lead financial forecasting, track utilization, ensure compliance, and proactively manage deviations and risks.

### **2\. Government Engagement \& Advocacy**

* Build and sustain strong partnerships with key state stakeholders, including:
	+ Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society (KREIS)
	+ DSERT / SCERT
	+ Samagra Shikshana Karnataka
	+ State Boards and allied institutions
* Represent Quest Alliance in state\-level forums, consultations, and review meetings.
* Advocate for institutionalization of Future Skills within curriculum, teacher training, and assessment frameworks.
* Ensure program indicators are integrated into government monitoring systems to enable mainstream implementation and reduce parallel processes.
* Mobilize government resources (budgets, venues, logistics, printing, training infrastructure, etc.) to support scale and sustainability.

### **3\. Program Delivery \& Quality Assurance**

* Work closely with the Learning Experience team to contextualize curriculum and ensure high\-quality implementation.
* Coordinate with the Associate Program Manager to support district\-level rollout and resolve operational challenges.
* Track progress rigorously using reviews, dashboards, data systems, and field insights to ensure timely achievement of targets with quality.
* Establish, strengthen, and monitor the Master Trainer cadre to enable statewide educator capacity building.
* Conduct regular field visits to gather qualitative insights and inform continuous program improvement.
* Ensure data\-driven decision\-making by integrating M\&E learnings into design, delivery, and planning.

### **4\. Internal Collaboration \& Governance**

* Actively contribute to organizational planning and cross\-team alignment processes.
* Ensure coordination with FAIT and other internal teams, tracking interdependencies using systems such as Jira.
* Maintain high standards of internal documentation, compliance, and governance.

### **5\. Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead and mentor the state team, ensuring role clarity, performance goals, and accountability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, and alignment with Quest values.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and support access to learning, capacity\-building, and exposure opportunities.
* Ensure staff welfare, adherence to HR processes, and inclusive workplace practices.
* Build strong M\&E capability within the team and ensure insights are consistently applied to delivery and planning.
* Uphold a culture of respectful, open, and professional communication.
* Drive self\-learning by setting annual development goals and completing planned learning journeys.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 10\+ years of experience leading large\-scale education or EdTech programs.
* Kannada language proficiency and ability engage Kannada\-speaking stakeholders.
* 5\-6\+ years of experience managing complex, state\-level initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of the Karnataka education ecosystem, NEP 2020, and SCERT/DSERT frameworks.
* Proven experience in educator capacity building and facilitating workshops with government officials.
* Strong financial management, budgeting, compliance, and data\-driven planning skills.
* High digital fluency, including Google Workspace and project management tools.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Karnataka.

 **Salary:** The pay band for the position starts at Rs. 1,25,000/\- per month (cost to company) (*The salary offered will be commensurate with the experience and expertise of the candidate)*

 **Benefits:**

  

In addition to your compensation, you are also eligible for a suite of benefits designed to support your well\-being and growth:

* Comprehensive Personal Accident Insurance covering up to ₹10,00,000 annually
* Mediclaim Insurance covering up to ₹3,00,000 annually, supported through our insurance partner, Loop, which also offers additional wellness benefits
* Reach for the Stars (RFS) amount of up to ₹5,000 to support your self\-learning and knowledge\-building efforts
* Internet allowance of up to ₹750/month, reimbursable based on actual usage to support flexible and hybrid working arrangements
* For employees with children under the age of 6 years, Quest offers childcare or day care fee support through a monthly matching contribution of up to ₹3,000, helping you create a supportive work\-life balance
* Access to emotional health and wellbeing programs such as:
* Group sessions worth ₹7,500 per session fully covered by the organisation
* 1:1 counselling sessions (worth ₹1,800 per session), fully covered by the organisation

 **To Apply:**


Interested candidates are requested to apply for the role by filling up the application form .

* Ability to drive **improved employee engagement** and strengthen regional workplace experience.
* Proven capability in building **strong recruitment pipelines** and enabling hiring managers to follow structured, value\-aligned hiring practices.

description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil Affiliates in India**
----------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

* ExxonMobil is seeking an experienced recruiter to join our dynamic global recruiting team driving competitive advantage through our people
* To be successful in this role, you must quickly build understanding of our business needs, employee value proposition and be in a position to translate business strategy and objectives into high\-value impact
* You will be a strategic, innovative, and a critical thinker who is outcome focused, a “driver” who effectively challenges organizational paradigms and has demonstrated ability to effectively lead transformational change
* You come with high ambition, high energy, tremendous work\-ethic, and a desire to be part of a winning team. If this sounds like you, we want you on the team!
**What you will do**
--------------------

  

* You will quickly cultivate an understanding of ExxonMobil’s businesses and relationships with senior leaders to understand their critical hiring needs
* Be a trusted strategic advisor to ExxonMobil’s leaders to ensure process rigor and efficiency in the pursuit of attracting and acquiring the best talent for the company
* You will develop and execute comprehensive search strategies with your business leaders to ensure an efficient and polished process for hiring managers and candidates alike
**About you**
-------------

* BA Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing or related field
* 10\+ years of progressive Recruiting experience across a variety of industries and functions. Experience in O\&G is plus.
* Experienced and comfortable using sourcing tools \& recruitment technology, ATS and CRM, recruitment dashboards, analytics \& reporting tools Language requirement
* Advanced English
* Experienced and comfortable sourcing independently and creatively (i.e. beyond LinkedIn) as well as partnering with a sourcer to find the best talent for our roles
* Comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful and solution\-oriented
* Strong work ethic, sense of urgency, adaptability, and ability to prioritize
* A positive attitude with dedication to problem solving and delivery
* High level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information
* Passionate about people and a natural instinct to help others, go above and beyond, and think ahead
* Exceptional oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in teams; share responsibility for results, provide and accept feedback
**Your Benefits**
-----------------

 **An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:**

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking \& cross\-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations \& holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development progra
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility

  

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

Learn more at our **website**  

Follow us on **LinkedIN**and**Instagram**  

Like us on **Facebook**  

Subscribe our channel at **YouTube**

ExxonMobil is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

  

Nothing herein is intended to override the corporate separateness of local entities. Working relationships discussed herein do not necessarily represent a reporting connection, but may reflect a functional guidance, stewardship, or service relationship.

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. It follows all administration processes to ensure tasks are completed correctly and resource efficiencies are maintained. The role works closely with Delivery Services Management to identify and escalate client issues, obtain and confirm pending information/documentation, and add and amend transaction information to client/systems responding to changes (via e\-mail/telephone) to maintain current visible HR records for the client. Primary Responsibilities / Accountabilities: • Read, understand, and analyze client processes as per the business rules. • Execute the full range of the process accurately and timely as a hands\-on processor. • Escalate issues and seek advice when faced with complex issues/problems. • Follow Work Instructions while processing. • Highlight any anomalies in Work Instructions/process documentation to the SME/Leads. • Participate in client conference calls, where required, and manage appropriate documentation. • Perform “Root Cause Analysis” on issues faced and suggest appropriate corrective action for current remediation and future control. • Propose process improvement ideas to reduce time, improve accuracy, or enhance controls. • Understand existing matrices in the process, how they are measured, and improvise the measurement system to make it more effective Functional Competencies: • Knowledge of Employee \& Org data Mgmt Processes (New Hires, Exit, Job Changes, etc.). • Strong command of written and verbal English language. • Knowledge of MS Office/Excel Skills would be a plus. • Knowledge of SuccessFactors would be a plus.  

**What are we looking for?** Skills / Knowledge: • Strong customer orientation \- high level of responsiveness to urgent requests or troubleshooting. • Resilient and able to work under pressure. • Organization \& prioritization skills to deliver as per deadlines. • Attention to detail \& quality driven – in communications and all system transactions. • Demonstrate high levels of confidentiality. • Teamwork \& collaboration. • Multi\-cultural awareness. • Flexible to work in shifts. • Update process metrics on a daily basis and maintain MIS. • Demonstrate the highest level of customer service. • Pay close attention to detail and follow through to resolve any outstanding issues. • Ensure both own and related tasks are completed. • Update client applications accurately and quickly in accordance with the appropriate User Guides. • Ensure assigned tasks are completed accurately in a timely fashion. • Ensure and maintain the security and confidentiality of client data. • Actively participate in team activities and organizational initiatives.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines • Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor • You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments • The decisions that you make would impact your own work • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

title: Talent Acquisition Executive – Volume Hiring (contractual)
description:
**City:** Gurugram  

**Department:** Human Resources
**Recruiter:** Tavleen BindraAt Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



We’re looking for a proactive and execution\-focused Talent Acquisition Executive – Volume Hiring to join our team in Gurugram on a 12\-month contractual role.



In this hybrid role, you will independently drive end\-to\-end recruitment for high\-volume positions, ensuring speed, quality, and accuracy at scale. You will act as a hands\-on hiring partner, managing multiple requisitions simultaneously, maintaining strong stakeholder confidence, and delivering hiring outcomes with minimal handholding.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment and wants to build strong expertise in volume hiring, stakeholder management, and data\-driven recruitment.


**About the role**


* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for volume hiring roles, from intake through sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and joining.
* Manage multiple concurrent requisitions while maintaining hiring quality, turnaround time, and process discipline.
* Build and sustain strong sourcing pipelines through job portals, referrals, social sourcing, and creative sourcing strategies.
* Ensure backup candidate pipelines are available for critical and time\-sensitive roles.
* Partner closely with hiring managers and stakeholders, providing clear updates on pipeline health, hiring progress, risks, and timelines.
* Use hiring data and market insights to set expectations and push back constructively when requirements are not aligned with market realities.
* Maintain high standards of data hygiene across ATS platforms and recruitment trackers, ensuring accurate and decision\-ready reporting.
* Support offer management and joining conversion to minimize candidate dropouts.
* Contribute to campus hiring activities when needed, including hiring program coordination, logistics, candidate data management, and stakeholder support.
* Help build strong candidate pipelines and contribute to longer\-term university and campus engagement efforts.


**About you**


* 2–4 years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in volume hiring or high\-scale recruitment roles.
* Graduate in any discipline.
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong working knowledge of ATS platforms such as Greenhouse and Workday.
* Good command of Excel, including filters, lookups, pivot tables, and basic reporting.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work effectively in deadline\-driven, fast\-paced environments.
* Strong communication, prioritisation, multitasking, and execution skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to use data to guide decisions, manage expectations, and improve hiring outcomes.
* Exposure to campus hiring is preferred.
* Openness to using AI tools, automation, and digital recruiting methods to improve efficiency.
* Immediate joiners preferred.
* Diversity candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.


**What we offer**


* Hybrid work model: 5\-day work week with 3 days in office and 2 days working from home.
* High\-impact hiring exposure: Gain hands\-on experience in large\-scale and business\-critical recruitment.
* Learning opportunity: Build expertise in volume hiring, recruitment operations, stakeholder management, and hiring analytics.
* Tech\-enabled environment: Work with modern ATS platforms, data\-led hiring practices, and evolving recruitment tools.
* Growth exposure: Strengthen skills that can support future growth into broader talent acquisition and specialist recruitment roles.


**Why Join Flix**



At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting\-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.  

If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Learning & Development Partner
description:
Hello Visionary!  

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal
addition to our vibrant international team.  

  

We are looking for a Learning \& Development Partner.  

The L\&D Partner collaborates with business leaders to identify capability gaps and design, deliver, and evaluate learning interventions that drive business performance. This role ensures alignment of learning initiatives with organizational goals while enabling continuous skill development across technical and behavioral domains.  

You’ll make a difference by:* Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into learning solutions
* Design and implement learning programs (technical, functional, and leadership)
* Handle end\-to\-end training lifecycle: needs analysis, design, delivery, evaluation
* Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and learning journeys
* Supervise learning efficiency using data, feedback, and business impact metrics
* Collaborate with internal trainers, SMEs, and external vendors.

  

You’ll win us over by:  

Technical Skills* Learning analytics \& reporting (Excel, Power BI or similar tools)
* LXP platforms (Wingspan)
* Instructional design fundamentals
* Adult Learning Principles
* Basic understanding of digital learning tools \& AI\-enabled learning trends


Non\-Technical Skills* Stakeholder management \& business partnering
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
* Problem\-solving and consulting attitude
* Project management and execution rigor
* Adaptability and continuous learning orientation


Experience Requirement* 5–8 years of experience in Learning \& Development / Talent Development
* Proven experience in handling end\-to\-end training programs
* Exposure to both technical and behavioral learning initiatives preferred


Qualification* MBA / PGDM in HR, Learning \& Development, or equivalent degree
* Certifications in Instructional Design / Coaching / Learning Technologies (preferred)

  

Join us and be yourself!  

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.  

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.  

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

title: Finance and HR Administrator
description:
**Finance, Accounting \& Compliance**


* Manage end\-to\-end payroll for India and Australia with full statutory compliance.
* Share monthly TDS, sales, and purchase data with the Indian accountant (TDS \& GST filings).
* Submit payroll and quarterly financial reports to the Australian accountant (GST compliance).
* Handle invoicing, accounts receivable, vendor payments, and employee reimbursements.
* Create and monitor projects in the time \& expense system; track budgets.
* Provide required documents to external accountants for monthly/annual financial statements.
* Review global expense reports and process reimbursements on time.
* Collect annual investment declarations and tax documents from employees.

  


**Operational \& Administrative Support**


* Maintain leave, overtime, and time\-tracking records; ensure timely approvals.
* Manage complete onboarding and offboarding processes in BambooHR, including documentation and formalities.
* Administer employee benefits such as health insurance, workmen’s compensation, and statutory benefits.
* Maintain training records and ensure completion of mandatory compliance programs.
* Update and maintain standardized employee and candidate resumes.
* Provide administrative support across HR, Finance, and Operations functions.
* Coordinate travel arrangements for business visits and project mobilization.
* Manage procurement, maintenance, and configuration of employee laptops and equipment.

  


**Skills \& Qualifications**

 **Technical Skills**


* Strong knowledge of payroll processing and statutory compliance (TDS, PF, ESI, GST, gratuity, etc.).
* Experience in invoicing, billing, accounts receivable, vendor payments, and expense management.
* Ability to prepare documentation for audits, tax filings, and financial reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRIS and ERP systems (BambooHR, Replicon preferred)

  


**Soft Skills**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills to meet global standard.
* Excellent cross\-functional coordination and stakeholder management.
* Must be self\-sufficient, independent, and able to work with minimal supervision.

  


**Experience**


* 4–8 years of progressive experience in Finance administration, payroll, or combined HR \& accounts roles, preferably supporting global teams


**Employment Type:** Fixed\-Term Contract (12 months), with the possibility of extension


**Remote work**

  

**Qualification:** B.com, M.com,  

MBA in Finance


**Experience Required:** 4–8 years


**Joining Period:** Immediate or within one month


**Company Website** : https://mmrconsulting.com/


**Submit resume to following email id**\- Varsha.Thorat@mmrconsulting.com

**Job Description**


GM – Learning and Development


Digital Marketing \& Ads Troubleshooting

**Role Overview**


13\+ years in Learning \& Development (L\&D) or Technical Training, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity within the AdTech or SaaS space.


As the GM / DGM – Learning and Development, you will be the architect of knowledge for our Ads Troubleshooting division in Gurgaon. This is a high\-stakes leadership role designed for a "teacher\-leader" who will lead a team of trainers responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of learning—from onboarding fresh talent to "up\-skilling" seasoned troubleshooters on complex topics

**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy \& Curriculum Design: Develop a multi\-tiered training roadmap that covers foundational Ads knowledge, deep\-dive technical troubleshooting, and "soft skills" for high\-stakes stakeholder management.
* New Hire Onboarding (NHT): Own the "Zero to Hero" journey. Ensure new recruits reach billable proficiency levels faster through immersive, simulation\-based learning environments.
* Continuous Learning \& Retraining: Identify knowledge gaps within the tenured team through quality audits and performance data. Design "Delta Training" modules for new product launches and policy updates.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with the Troubleshooting Senior Manager and Product Specialists to align training content with real\-world "pain points" seen in the queue.
* L\&D Analytics: Define and track metrics for training effectiveness, such as Time to Proficiency, NHT Quality Scores, and the correlation between training interventions and performance metrics
* Mentorship: Lead and coach a team of technical trainers, helping them evolve from subject matter experts into world\-class educators.

**Key Skills**


Digital Marketing and understanding of Ads Trouble shooting is desired. Expert\-level knowledge of adult learning principles. The ability to pivot training materials within the prescribed time in response to a global product rollout.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 12\-18 years of total experience, with a heavy focus on Technical Training or Instructional Design within a global captive or Tier\-1 BPO/Tech firm.
* Proven track record of managing training functions for teams of 50\+ heads.
* Expertise in Learning Management Systems (LMS) and content authoring tools.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Communications, or a technical field.
* Google Ads Certification: (Search, Display, Measurement, and Video).
* Data Literacy: Ability to use SQL or Data Studio to visualize the impact of training on operational KPIs.
* Understanding of the local talent landscape and cultural nuances in professional development

  

**Certifications Required**


Certified Professional in Learning and Performance (CPLP) or equivalent certification in learning and development.

We are a high caliber team who appreciate and support one another. Our people uphold an energetic, collaborative and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

* We take care of our people, clients, company, communities and climate by doing what’s right.
* We foster an innovative environment where you can build the career path that’s right for you.

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. Headquartered in the U.S., Cognizant (a member of the NASDAQ\-100 and one of Forbes World’s Best Employers 2025\) is consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world. title: Regional Talent Acquisition Supervisor
description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil Affiliates in India**
----------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

* ExxonMobil is seeking a strong, experienced talent acquisition leader to join our dynamic global talent acquisition leadership team, driving competitive advantage through our people
* To be successful in this role, you must quickly build an understanding of our business needs, and be in a position to translate business strategy and objectives into high\-value impact
* You are strategic, innovative, and a critical thinker who is outcome focused; a “driver” who effectively challenges organizational paradigms and has demonstrated ability to effectively lead transformational change
* You understand how integrated value is delivered, with demonstrated success working across organizational boundaries and a track record of performing successfully in global, matrixed environments
* You are curious, forward\-looking, and have a keen desire to understand issues and leverage external perspectives and apply them effectively within an ExxonMobil context, focused on providing recommendations that maximize recruiting performance and ultimately enable business success
* You come with high ambition, high energy, tremendous work\-ethics, and a desire to be part of a winning team.
* If this sounds like you, we want you on the team!
**What you will do**

description:

Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Benefits \& Leave Administration Senior Associate**

**Location:** Noida/Hyderabad India

 **Overview**


The Senior Associate will support the administration of employee benefits, retirement programs, and leave of absence processes for both U.S. and India employee populations. This role focuses on delivering accurate, compliant, and timely execution of programs while serving as a key point of contact for employee inquiries and operational support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Benefits Administration**

* Provide day\-to\-day support for benefits operations, including responding to employee inquiries and resolving issues.
* Assist with benefits enrollment activities, including open enrollment and life event changes.
* Ensure accurate processing and maintenance of benefit elections in HR systems.
* Coordinate with vendors/carriers to resolve discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.
* Support employee communications and education related to benefits programs.

**Leave of Absence Administration**

* Support the administration of leave of absence programs including FMLA, short\-term disability (STD), Earned \& Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Maternity / Paternity Leave, and other applicable leave policies.
* Provide guidance and information to employees and managers on leave processes, documentation, and timelines.
* Track leave cases, maintain accurate records, and ensure timely updates in HR systems.
* Assist in communicating leave status, approvals, and return\-to\-work timelines to relevant stakeholders.
* Support compliance with applicable regulations (e.g., FMLA, ADA, and local labor laws).

**Retirement \& Retiree Benefits**

* Support the administration of retirement and retiree benefit programs including Provident Fund and National Pension Scheme.
* Assist with retiree benefit processing and provide support during employee retirement transitions.
* Maintain accurate records and respond to retiree\-related inquiries.
* Ensure timely and accurate execution of retiree benefits processes.

**Compliance \& Reporting**

* Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with benefits, retirement, and leave regulations and policies across U.S. and India programs.
* Assist with audits, reporting requirements, and regulatory filings as needed.
* Generate and maintain reports related to leave, benefits, and retirement programs.

**Worker’s Compensation Support**

* Assist in coordinating and tracking worker’s compensation claims.
* Support documentation, reporting, and follow\-ups to meet compliance requirements.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data management.
* Solid understanding of benefits, retirement, and leave processes.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or similar field
* 3–6 years of experience in benefits and leave of absence
* Experience supporting U.S. and India benefits and leave programs preferred.
* Experience working with HR systems and benefits platforms preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (Benefits and /or Absence modules) strongly preferred.
* HR certification (e.g., PHR/SHRM\-CP) is a plus.

* **Core Expertise:** Proven mastery of LS\-DYNA explicit solver for impact and crash dynamics.

* **Domain Knowledge:** Strong foundation in structural dynamics, impact mechanics, continuum mechanics, and road safety metrics.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s in Mechanical, Automotive, or Structural Engineering.
* **Additional Skills:** Experience with regulatory codes, model validation, and Python scripting for automation is a plus.

**What We Offer**

* A cutting\-edge environment tackling complex physics in road safety and mobility.
* Hands\-on work with state\-of\-the\-art Digital Twin technologies.
* Clear career progression in computational engineering and simulation leadership.

Apply now to shape the future of safe, resilient structures!

**About the company**

Crescent Engineering \& Consulting (CEC) is an engineering\-first consulting and technology firm that helps manufacturing businesses transform through design, automation, and production optimization. Our team blends mechanical engineering expertise with digital systems, offering services that span CAD/CAE, product development, manufacturing automation, ERP implementation, and process optimization.

Operating under the Built by Engineers. Driven by Results. philosophy, Crescent bridges the gap between technology and manufacturing reality. We work with small and mid\-sized manufacturing firms across India to make their operations smarter, faster, and more profitable — combining engineering precision with real\-world execution.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Junior Business Development Engineer to support our growing sales pipeline.

This role is designed for an engineering graduate who is curious about manufacturing problems and interested in the business side of engineering services.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Sales Manager, supporting early\-stage outreach, identifying potential engineering opportunities, and conducting initial technical discussions with prospective clients. The objective is to identify real engineering challenges within manufacturing companies and help convert them into qualified opportunities for the sales team.

This role is not a tele calling position. It focuses on meaningful conversations with manufacturing businesses to understand their design, automation, and engineering requirements.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Connect with manufacturing companies across target industries.
* Identify potential opportunities related to engineering design, automation, CAD/CAE, and production optimization.
* Conduct initial discussions with prospective clients to understand their engineering challenges and requirements.
* Qualify prospects and schedule meetings for the Sales Manager.
* Maintain accurate lead records and update CRM systems regularly.
* Assist in preparing proposals, quotations, and client documentation.
* Follow up with prospects after meetings and maintain engagement.
* Research manufacturing companies and identify potential engineering opportunities.
* Participate in exhibitions, trade shows, and industry events when required.
* Coordinate between sales, engineering, and management teams during early project discussions.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* Other engineering disciplines may be considered if the candidate demonstrates strong interest in manufacturing and engineering businesses.
* Experience: 0 \- 3 years relevant experiance
* Freshers are welcome to apply

**Skills \& Attributes**

* Strong curiosity about how manufacturing companies operate.
* Ability to understand engineering problems at a conceptual level.
* Good communication skills with confidence in speaking with professionals from industry.
* Analytical thinking and structured problem understanding.
* Self\-motivated with a willingness to learn about engineering services and business development.
* Organized and capable of maintaining structured records of leads and discussions.
* Basic familiarity with LinkedIn, Excel/Sheets, and presentation tools.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating with the internal sales team.

**Why Join Us**

* Gain real exposure to engineering sales and business development in manufacturing industries.
* Work closely with experienced engineers and business leaders.
* Understand how engineering problems translate into real\-world business opportunities.
* Learn how design, automation, and manufacturing consulting projects are initiated and executed.

 This role serves as the operational backbone of Learning \& Development, ensuring consistent, compliant, and scalable delivery of learning initiatives that are prioritized and designed by L\&D Capability Strategy (Learning Partners) and Specialist teams.
 



 The role is focused on operational excellence, control, and scale—enabling learning delivery to run predictably and efficiently across the firm. It does not have learning strategy, design, or outcomes.

**Learning Delivery Operations** 



* Lead end‑to‑end learning delivery operations, including administration, scheduling, logistics, learner communications, completion tracking, data capture, and issue resolution for approved learning interventions
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution across instructor‑led, virtual, and digital learning formats
* Drive standardization of delivery processes to enable scale, consistency, and audit readiness



  





**Governance, Controls \& Shared Services Excellence** 



* Own operational governance for L\&D delivery, including SLAs, turnaround times, quality standards, and exception management
* Lead capacity planning, workload balancing, backlog control, and demand volatility management to ensure predictable throughput
* Identify systemic risks, delivery constraints, and recurring issues; escalate through defined governance mechanisms with data‑backed insights



  





**Learning Technology Operations (LMS / LXP)** 



* Own operational usage, configuration hygiene, data integrity, and reporting for LMS and LXP platforms
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of learning data, including enrolments, completions, certifications, and compliance reporting
* Partner with HR Technology and IT teams on system enhancements, integrations, and releases (without owning platform roadmap or vendor product decisions)



  





**People Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Lead and develop the L\&D Operations team, with clear accountability for:
* Delivery capacity and throughput
* SLA and quality performance
* Skills development and role clarity

description:

We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**JOB SUMMARY (Roles \& Responsibilities)** 




 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and efficient HR Operations Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in managing payroll, overseeing the offboarding process, ensuring compliance, and maintaining accurate employee databases. This role requires strong organizational skills, a keen eye for detail, and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality and accuracy in all tasks.
 



  





**KEY RESULT AREAS** 




  





**· HR Systems Administration** 



* System Admin: SuccessFactors, GreytHR, BGV Portal
* Integrations with Successfactors: Biometric System, LinkedIn Learning \& R\&R portals.
* HR Tools Training of New Joiners.
* New Configurations \& Bug Fixes via IT Support consultants
* HRIS Reporting \- System based accurate and customized reports as per requirement



  





**Employee Data Management** 



* Ensuring 100% accurate and real time data updates in HR Systems
* Creating new entities, positions, departments, locations, jobs etc in SuccessFactors to ensure standardization
* Maintaining Employee's physical Personnel Files with required documents as per HR SOP.



  





**Payroll** 



* Process monthly payroll, ensuring accuracy in employee salary calculations, tax deductions, and statutory contributions.
* Collaborate with finance and other departments to resolve payroll discrepancies.
* Maintain and update payroll records in compliance



  





**Customer Support** 



* Employee Query resolution pertaining to SF
* GreytHR Query resolution pertaining to policies
* BGV for exited employees



  





**Onboarding** 



* Ensuring accurate employee data at time of onboarding.
* Issuance of Appointment Letters \- Same day with copy in file
* Background Verification for all new joiners
* Employee Personnel File Creation



  





**Offboarding** 



* Timely completion of exit process along with settlement of final dues in GreytHR along with ensuring proper
* Closing full \& Final Settlement of dues within 10 days along with experience letter issuance
* Employee Personnel File Closure and movement to digital File Cabinet



  





**Compliance (Company)** 



* Quarterly, half yearly \& annual returns as per applicable statutes for all Entities, New Company Registrations \- As per the defined schedules
* Publish Compliance calendar \- Monthly publish to Company Secretary.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies.
* Liaise with Compliance consultants empaneled to ensure company compliance is 100% on all the applicable statutes



  





**Compliance (Contractor)** 



* New site registrations, renewals, amendments under CLRA, BOCW, ISMW, Trade License, Shop acts
* BOCW Penetration
* Compliance Audits \& Penetration
* Timely Escalations \- Monthly MIS to flag 100% critical concerns
* Compliance Awareness sessions



  





**Compensation and Benefits Support** 



* Monthly Payroll Tracking v/s Budget. YTD Salary Reports
* Timely and accurate date sharing \- reports received as per timelines set
* Annual Increment Cycle \- Data accuracy \& system readiness \- as per the deadlines defined



  





**Preferred Qualifications, Skills \& Knowledge** 



* University degree or equivalent in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management
* High degree of integrity and adherence to SOPs
* Should be well versed with HR Systems and have logical and analytical mindset
* HR Reporting via Excel and HRMS tools
* 2\-5 yrs experience in HR Operations

title: People Support Services Partner
description:
Location: Noida, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Primary Purpose Of Role**
 The People Services Partner role is aligned to the Thales HR organization and will provide HR services to various regions. The role will provide first level support to employees, HR, managers and vendors with Human Resources needs, including but not limited to company policy, procedures, learning, HR systems, employee onboarding etc. ensuring all SLA’s are met.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities**
**Case Management:**
* Respond to a wide variety of employee queries.
* Thoroughly document inquiries via the case management tool to ensure required information is recorded accurately in accordance with policies and practices.
* Track and follow up on employee\-related matters.
* Ensure SLA’s are followed and met.


**Onboarding:**
* Complete and track new hire activities from offer letter creation through the end of their onboarding.
* Initiate any business\-specific tasks required during the onboarding process.
* Coordinate immigration and relocation processes and interact with immigration consultants and vendors to establish correct documentation, procedures, and requirements for external hires.
* Communicate with the new hire regarding next steps, outstanding actions, and any questions they may have.
* Support the Talent Acquisition Team with any requisition corrections or troubleshoot any difficulties.
* Track and monitor probation completion.


**HRIS:**
* Ensure integrity and quality of data in the HRIS databases as well as in the Case Management System.
* Support HRIS data records and workflow pertaining to employees and ensure entries are timely, accurate and consistent in relation to employee data.
* Support generation of standard HRIS reports as requested.
* Participate with testing in instances for new HRIS rollouts.


**Employee Data Management:**
* Ensure integrity and quality of data in the HRIS databases as well as in the Case Management System.
* Support HRIS data records and workflow pertaining to employees and ensure entries are timely, accurate and consistent in relation to cost center transfers, collective agreements, etc.
* Review employee transactions and generate appropriate documents and letters as needed.
* Escalate any Tier 2 HRIS issues to the relevant team.


**Training:**
* Update available courses and training records in the Learning Management System (LMS).
* Assist employees and managers in the use of the LMS.
* Schedule requested trainings.
* Assist in preparing training materials as needed for internally hosted events.
* Manage procurement requisitions and invoicing related to courses and training materials.


**Talent and Performance**
* Generate reports as required
* Support transactions in Workday to support processes
* Support manager and employees on process queries


**Offboarding**
* Coordinate and trigger voluntary post\-termination activities such as post\-termination letters and departure checklists
* Complete all post termination actions e.g enrolling in alumni networks, removal from any assigned future events
* Consolidate exit insights results


**Other:**
* Initiate employee notifications as required.
* Prepare various employee letters in a timely manner outside of the HRIS workflow (letter of employment/employment verification, invitation letters, salary and merit letters etc.).
* Participate in audits as needed (probation, data checks).
* Contribute to the development of HR process documents and employee reference materials.
* Maintain knowledge of company and departmental policies and procedures.
* Support Thales’ HR department with special projects, mass communications, and other duties as needed and assigned.


**Experience and Skills:**
* Either 2\-years of experience in of experience working in HR or an administrative support role or a University Degree or Diploma in Human Resources or a related field
* Proficient in English (both written and oral).
* Ability to work well and collaborate in a team environment.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Ability to handle situations tactfully when dealing with customers.
* Ability to prioritize duties during periods of high volume and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong time management skills (meeting SLAs).
* Discretion to deal with personal and confidential information with sensitivity and tact.
* Adaptable to changing business practices.
* Proficient with Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Solid critical thinking skills.


**Highly Desirable:**
* Prior experience with ServiceNow or another HR case management tool.
* Prior experience with Workday or similar HRIS systems.
* Knowledge of HR practices either through post\-secondary education, an HR professional designation, and/or work experience in HR.
* Experience in a customer service or shared services environment.


 Education and Qualifications:
   

  

* A Graduate Degree.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in designing and implementing networking systems.
* 3 years of experience with TCP/IP\-based, routing, and network management protocols.
* Experience in network protocols, architectures, methodologies, and in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with planning and designing large\-scale networks (e.g., multiple sites, multiple products, etc.).
* Experience with Wide Area Network (WAN) technologies, including disaggregated networking or software\-defined networking concepts.
* Experience with modern network management interfaces and protocols (e.g., gRPC, gNMI, OpenConfig).
* Ability to lead technical initiatives and influence Engineering teams.


**About The Job**
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.
   

  

 Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define, and develop the implementation of test strategies and architectures for critical WAN infrastructure projects.
* Design and execute comprehensive functional, integration, performance, and system\-level testing for complex network devices and management systems.
* Drive the creation and enhancement of scalable test automation frameworks, tools, and infrastructure.
* Collaborate closely with Network Architecture, Software Engineering, and Product teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle and influence design for testability.
* Diagnose and resolving complex issues across multi\-vendor network environments.
