 with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in designing, implementing, monitoring, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructures. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, performance, and security of network systems while supporting business and operational needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data center networks
* Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers
* Monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, and perform root cause analysis
* Ensure network security through proper configuration, patching, and access control
* Manage network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures
* Perform network upgrades, migrations, and capacity planning
* Work closely with system administrators, security teams, and vendors
* Support cloud and hybrid network environments (AWS/Azure/GCP – if applicable)
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry best practices
* Provide Level 2/Level 3 network support and on\-call support when required


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT.
* 3–5 years of experience in network engineering or network administration
* Strong knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP)
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, or similar networking devices
* Experience with firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco ASA)
* Understanding of VLANs, VPNs, NAT, QoS, and STP
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG, etc.)
* Basic knowledge of network security principles and best practices
* Experience with Linux/Windows networking is a plus


**Preferred Skills**
* Networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent
* Experience with SD\-WAN and wireless networking

title: Networking Test Engineer
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience working with and testing multiple L2 and L3 networking protocols as well as troubleshooting automation.
* 2 years of experience in Network Test Automation, Programming, Coding (Python or Go).
* Experience with test methodologies, writing test plans and creating test cases.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's or PhD in in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in specialized testing such as production testing, system integration testing, functional and performance testing etc.
* Experience architecting and developing test infrastructure to support the network solutions.
* Experience with testing or releasing networking products.


**About The Job**
 Our computational challenges are so big and unique we can't just buy our hardware, we've got to make it ourselves. Our Platforms Team designs and builds the hardware, software and networking technologies that power all of Google's services. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large\-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

* Manage testing and releases of networking products, including managing timelines and project plans.
* Write and review test plans with teams, including identifying and gathering requirements to test networking features of a moderate to high\-complexity project, participate in cross\-functional reviews with related teams which cover test plans and test results.

 Responsibility for H\&S practices
 



  




* Management \& control of contractors
* Knowledge of network monitoring and other administrative tools
* Knowledge of networking technologies and protocols.

* Flexibility to assist in the 24 / 7 / 365 Network Operations Team.

* Understanding of working in Data Centers and Comms Rooms/Exchanges.
* Competency in handling AC/DC power
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Self\-motivated
* Excellent written and communication skills
* Creative problem\-solving abilities
* Mainly US business hour shifts



  





 Core Competencies
 



  





 Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.
 



 •
 



 Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self\-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.
 



 •
 



 Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, and techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational, or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem\-solving appropriately to diverse situations.
 



 •
 



 Root Cause Analysis: Knowledge of the concepts, principles, and techniques of root cause analysis (RCA); ability to use a structured approach to identify the underlying causes of problems in a particular environment and the changes needed to prevent recurrences.
 



 •
 



 IP Technologies and Protocols: Knowledge of the features and policies of IP technologies and protocols; ability to configure, deploy and support IP\-based networks and services.
 



 •
 



 IP\-based Services: Knowledge of the features and functions of IP\-based services; ability to configure, deploy and support TCP/IP\-based networks and associated services.
 



 •
 



 Troubleshooting Network Problems: Knowledge of tools and techniques to troubleshoot network problems; ability to anticipate, recognize and resolve technical (network, hardware, software, equipment or operational) problems.
 



 Universal Competencies
 



 •
 



 Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes and enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results\-oriented.
 



 •
 



 Customer First (Customer Facing): Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level.
 



 •
 



 Operational Excellence: Understanding the system\-driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re\-focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends

**▪ Experience With Firewalls, Barracuda Preferred.**

****Position Summary:****
 We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Network Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our organization's network security infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for protecting network systems from cyber threats, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data across all systems and networks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and Implementation: Develop and design secure network architecture and infrastructure (firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD\-WAN, Cloud Networks, etc.)

* Troubleshooting and Support: Monitor network performance, troubleshoot network problems and outages, schedule updates, and collaborate with network architects on network optimization. Provide technical support and guidance to users, possibly including training non\-technical staff

* Performance Monitoring: Monitor network performance and integrity, resolve issues using data from different network monitoring tools. Analyze network data to predict potential issues or bottlenecks

* Documentation: Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and network configurations

* Good understanding of networking protocols (e.g., IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802\.11, 802\.1x, QoS)

* Familiarity with Cloud networking (vnet peering, vpc, etc. in Azure, AWS)

* Ability to create accurate network diagrams and documentation for designing and planning network communication systems
* Strong analytical skills, able to work independently, and must be able to report on network operational status by gathering and prioritizing information

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to be part of the AU Bank Datacenter Network Team. The role involves hands\-on management of enterprise\-grade network infrastructure, translating application and business requirements into robust network solutions, and ensuring secure, compliant, and highly available datacenter operations. The candidate will work closely with application, security, and operations teams in a regulated banking environment.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Datacenter Network Operations \& Engineering
+ Provide hands\-on support and management of network devices including Firewalls, Network Switches, Routers, Load Balancers, and Web Application Firewalls (WAF).
+ Manage and support datacenter switching and routing environments using Cisco and Arista platforms.
+ Design, implement, and support scalable network solutions aligned with application and business needs.

* Solution Design \& Stakeholder Collaboration
+ Understand requirements from application and functional teams and translate them into effective network infrastructure solutions.
+ Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure network readiness for new applications and services.

* Security, Compliance \& Audits
+ Manage firewalls such as Palo Alto and FortiGate, and Web Application Firewalls including F5 ASM / Advanced WAF.
+ Support and manage internal, external, and regulatory IT/network audits.
+ Ensure adherence to banking, regulatory, and security compliance requirements.

* Load Balancing \& Traffic Management
+ Configure and manage F5 Load Balancers including LTM, GTM, and ASM modules.
+ Support application delivery, traffic optimization, and high availability through load balancing solutions.

* Advanced Troubleshooting \& Monitoring
+ Perform advanced packet\-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark and TCP Dump.
+ Diagnose and resolve complex network and application\-related incidents.
+ Apply strong analytical skills to handle high\-severity network incidents impacting business applications.

* Technologies \& Protocols
+ Work on advanced routing and switching protocols including BGP, VXLAN, and BGP EVPN.
+ Implement and support SD\-WAN solutions in enterprise environments.
+ Troubleshoot SSL/TLS\-related issues including certificates, cipher suites, and handshake failures.

* Vendor \& Team Management
+ Coordinate with OEMs and vendors to ensure timely delivery, support, and issue resolution.
+ Provide guidance, mentoring, and technical leadership to internal network teams.


**Success Metrics (first 12 months)**
* High availability and stability of datacenter network infrastructure.
* Timely resolution of network incidents and reduced downtime.
* Successful completion of regulatory and IT/network audits with minimal observations.
* Effective delivery of network solutions aligned with application and business needs.


**Must\-Have Qualifications**
* 5–8 years of total experience in IT Network Infrastructure management.
* 3–4 years of experience in a Bank or NBFC environment.
* Strong foundational knowledge of TCP/IP, OSI model, and core networking principles.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise firewalls, load balancers, and datacenter networking technologies.
* Experience managing internal, external, and regulatory network audits.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills for network and application\-related incidents.
* Knowledge of ITSM processes and incident management practices.


**Technical Skills**
* Firewalls: Palo Alto, FortiGate
* Web Application Firewall: F5 ASM / Advanced WAF
* Load Balancer: F5 LTM / GTM / ASM
* Datacenter Networking: Cisco, Arista
* Routing \& Switching Protocols: BGP, VXLAN, BGP EVPN
* SD\-WAN Solutions
* Troubleshooting Tools: Wireshark, TCP Dump
* SSL/TLS, Certificates, Cipher Suites

description:
In 3DEXPERIENCE Platform, we are currently seeking a skilled User Assistance Developer (technical writer) to support the 3DExperience User Assistance team. As a member of the 3DEXPERIENCE User Assistance team, you will play a critical role in empowering our users. Our mission is to design, develop, and continuously evolve content that is thorough, engaging, and easy to navigate. You will ensure that every user can onboard quickly and work effectively by providing the right information at the exact moment they need it.
   

  

**Role Description \& Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a skilled User Assistance Developer who can translate complex technical concepts into clear, user‑focused documentation. You will partner with developers, QA engineers, and product managers to produce and maintain high‑quality help content, UI text, and visual assets while championing the use of AI/LLM tools to boost productivity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze \& explain complex technical subjects and application functionality.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, and product managers to gather accurate information and understand user scenarios.
* Write \& Edit user assistance content (help topics, release notes, UI strings) following Dassault Systèmes style guides (Microsoft Manual of Style, Chicago Manual, etc.).
* Maintain Consistency across all documentation, ensuring technical accuracy and flawless grammar.
* Review UI Text for clarity, brevity, and usability; suggest improvements that make the interface more intuitive.
* Refresh Existing Content and create new material that meets quality standards.
* Leverage AI/LLM Tools (e.g., generative assistants, term‑extraction bots) to automate repetitive tasks and accelerate authoring.
* Produce Visuals – create or edit images, GIF’s, diagrams, short videos, and other media that complement written guidance.
* Contribute to Process Improvements – propose workflow enhancements, templates, or automation that increase team efficiency.


**Experience with any of the following (or similar) is a plus:**
* Programming/scripting (especially web development or XML, or AI/LLM)
* XMetaL Author, Oxygen XML Editor, or any other XML Authoring tool
* Graphics or video creation/analysis
* Knowledge of Microsoft Manual of Style or Chicago Manual of Style
* Usage of AI tools/Companion in technical writing domain


**Qualifications**
* B.E/B.Tech with 0 to 4 years of experience
* BSc in science, computer science, or in a writing\-intensive field such as English or Communications.
* Certification in Technical Writing
* Good command over English language
* Exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills
* Ability to work independently and meet project objectives


**What's In It For You**
* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Ensure knowledge sharing within the team
* Able to work well in a team environment and communicate effectively with co\-workers, both local and remote.
* Working with a Multinational culture company.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview \& Key Responsibilities)**
**How you’ll help us Keep Climbing (overview \& key responsibilities):**
* Responsible for overall development, authoring, and management of aircraft work cards for all Delta Air Lines fleets in accordance with FAA\-approved programs and engineering documents.
* Must ensure compliance to FAA Regulations, Engineering documentation, and other substantiating data as outlined in the Technical Operation Policies \& Procedures (TOPP).
* Monitor workflow for compliance and conduct internal audits to ensure regulatory adherence.
* Collaborate with departments including Maintenance, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Production Control to maintain Delta standards.
* Ensure work cards comply with FARs, Airworthiness Directives (ADs), and fleet maintenance program procedures.
* Incorporate safety\-conscious behaviors into all operational processes and work card content.
* Revise and coordinate changes with the Lower Order Check Program to maintain compliance with Technical Operations Policy and Procedures (TOPP).
* Complete Maintenance Data Change Requests through Delta\-approved applications and track progress for completeness.
* Review existing work cards and related documents for compliance with Delta and regulatory standards.
* Perform “Second Set of Eyes” reviews for new and existing projects.
* Develop strategic and tactical plans fostering a safety\-conscious environment for employee well\-being.
* Work in collaboration with Senior engineers within the team in meeting business objectives.
* Position requires a thorough knowledge of commercial aviation documentation and guidance specifications (i.e. ATA 100, iSpec2200, S1000D, and etc).


**Role Summary**
 The Technical Writer will be responsible for the following support of Delta’s Technical Operations division.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**
**What you need to succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* Aircraft Maintenance Engineering license (or applicable degree) with direct experience as a Technical Writer.
* 4\-8 years of experience in total inclusive of AME and Technical writer within the Aviation sector (Aircraft Structures, Systems and Propulsion)
* Must have previous aircraft maintenance experience with thorough knowledge and understanding of aircraft manuals (Aircraft Maintenance Manual (AMM), Illustrated Parts Catalog (IPC), Engine Maintenance Manual (EMM), etc. used for inspecting, troubleshooting and repairing of aircraft and engines.
* Should be a self\-starter with excellent written and verbal communications skills, able to handle several projects simultaneously with minimum supervision, must be well\-organized, and able to prioritize work to meet established deadlines.
* Ability to interpret task requirements and develop safe, effective, and compliant maintenance procedures.
* Must have very strong computer skills with knowledge and experience in structured authoring preferred (SGML, S1000D, XML, and etc).
* Must embrace diverse people, thinking, and styles.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Ability to work in collaborative environments and embrace diverse perspectives.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, express thoughts and ideas effectively, and embrace cultural differences with respect when engaging with others.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build strong partnerships.
* Prioritize, maintain focus, and consistently deliver commitment.
* Proactively understand customer expectations and willingness to create customer\-based solutions.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**
**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**
* Experience in MS Office products, Epic Editor, CORENA Studio, MS Office products and Adobe Professional highly preferred.


**About The Company**
**Delta Air Lines** 
 (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award\-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
   

  

 In 2024, Delta was recognized by Fortune with a No. 11 placement on
 **Fortune’s Top 50 Most Admired Companies** 
 list. The company’s strong management and commitment to providing elevated experiences and premium products also secured a No. 1 ranking out of the eight airlines on the list. Delta landed on
 **TIME’s** 
 inaugural list of the
 **“World’s Best Companies,”** 
 coming in at No. 12 – the only U.S. airline in the top 155\. TIME’s award is based on three criteria: employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability.
   

  

 Delta’s people\-first culture continues to be recognized, earning the airline a spot on
 **Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For®** 
 list for the fifth year. Delta is the only airline included on the 2024 list.
   

  

 Additionally, Delta earned a coveted spot, on
 **Fast Company** 
 ’s list of the
 **Most Innovative Companies,** 
 climbing from its No. 8 spot in 2023 to No. 2 in the travel category. The airline was recognized for its Wi\-Fi revolution that is working to ensure the future of travel is connected.
   

  

**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
 Delta has fast emerged as a customer\-focused, innovation\-led, technology\-enabled business. The Delta Technology Hub will contribute directly to these objectives. It will sustain our long\-term aspirations of delivering niche, IP\-intensive, high\-value, and innovative solutions. It supports various teams and functions across Delta and is an integral part of our transformation agenda, working seamlessly with a distributed team to create memorable experiences for customers.
   

  

**“Why join?”:**
* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Collaborate with research, innovation and IP co\-development partners.
* Immerse yourself in an employee\-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting\-edge technology driven solutions.

 SENIOR TECHNICAL WRITER \- TECHNICAL WRITING

* Self\-starter, proactive, and team player.

* Ability to physically perform general office requirements.
* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations.

title: Frontend Engineer (India)
description:
**About Onehouse**
 Onehouse is a mission\-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock\-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud\-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute\-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real\-time AI / ML).
   

  

 We are a team of self\-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large\-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self\-optimizing data lake platform!
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2\-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category \- the transactional data lake. The Product Engineering team is the glue that binds all of this together. We enable our data platform and infrastructure teams to be successful by acting as the foundation of a truly cloud native product.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Drive:**
* You aren't just building a UI; you are building the command center for the transactional data lake. Your work sits at the intersection of complex distributed systems and high\-performance user interfaces.
* Architecting AI\-Native Data Experiences: You will lead the development of generative AI interfaces that allow users to talk to their data infrastructure. Imagine building natural language interfaces that auto\-generate schemas or debug complex data pipelines in real\-time.
* Visualizing Massive Scale: You’ll solve the "dense data" problem—crafting performant, intuitive visualizations for petabyte\-scale data flows using React, Next.js and Typescript, ensuring that managing a global data lake feels as simple as managing a spreadsheet.
* Bridging the gRPC Gap: You will help define how we stream complex infrastructure states to the frontend, leveraging gRPC\-web to create a snappy, low\-latency experience that feels "local" even when managing remote cloud clusters.
* Defining a Category: As an early hire, your DNA will be in the product. You’ll influence the UX patterns of a new industry category, moving the needle from "clunky enterprise software" to "elegant cloud\-native platform."


**A Typical Day:**
* No two days are the same in a scaling startup, but here is what your rhythm looks like:
* Getting Started: You start with a sync with your lead engineers. You might be discussing how to build new feature into product with right approach.
* Deep Work Phase: You’re in the zone with Next.js and gRPC, building out a sophisticated features. You’re likely writing new shared components to ensure our UI is as robust as our backend.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You will work with EM/PMs to discuss upcoming features and define next milestones.
* State Management \& Logic: You spend time optimising our Firebase integration for real\-time notifications or wiring up gRPC services to ensure the frontend is perfectly synced with the underlying infrastructure.
* Direct Impact: You ship code that immediately improves how our customers interact with transactional data.
* Oncall: You will build alerts, logging and sophisticated tooling to make sure customer experience never degrades.


**What You Bring to the Table:**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Frontend engineer with experience developing and operating frontend applications
* Experience with React and gRPC.
* Operational excellence in monitoring/deploying/testing frontend applications.
* Great problem\-solving skills, a keen eye for details
* Quick decision making, self\-driven and able to balance to feature development and tech debt
* Clear communication skills
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience with Firebase or equivalent DB.
* Experience working on a SaaS product.


**How We'll Take Care Of You**
* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health \& Well\-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well\-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
* Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well\-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
* Location; we are a remote\-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America \+ India), though some roles will be subject to in\-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 11 paid company holidays
* Food \& Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in\-office snacks/drinks
* Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one\-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
* Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents \- fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition


**House Values**
**One Team**
*Optimize for the company, your team, self \- in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co\-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of.*
**Tough \& Persevering**
*We are building our company in a very large, fast\-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!*
**Keep Making It Better Always**
*Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty\-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward.*
**Think Big, Act Fast**
*We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns.*
**Be Customer Obsessed**
*Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company.*

 **Hyland Software** is widely known as a great company to work for and a great company to do business with. The Learning Systems Specialist 3 is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for the administration optimization and ongoing evolution of the company’s learning management system (LMS) and broader learning ecosystem. This role serves as the primary LMS owner for Learning \& Organizational Development enabling scalable data\-driven and personalized learning experiences across the organization. description:
**Zonal HR Support ( HRBP)**


**Key Responsibilities:**



1\. **Monthly Town Hall /Open House Sessions**


**Objective:** Enhance employee engagement, provide corporate updates, and gather feedback.


* **Frequency:** Conduct a minimum of **8 sessions**per month at sites with 50\+ headcount and critical locations.


* **Key Deliverables:**


* Explain employee benefits, corporate updates, employee welfare



programs, and social benefits.


* Address employee queries related to salary, PF, ESIC, mediclaim,



etc.


* Conduct employee engagement activities, including Reward and



Recognition (R\&R) programs where feasible.


* Identify high\-potential employees for succession planning during



interactions.


* Detect early signs of attrition, especially among potential HiPo



employees, and take preventive measures.


* **Documentation:**


* Prepare detailed session reports, including attendance, feedback,



concerns raised, and action items.


* Maintain a standard template for communication to stakeholders.


* Keep records of identified HiPo employees and attrition risk cases



for follow\-up.



2\. **Communication of the Escalation Matrix**


**Objective:** Ensure employees are aware of the escalation process for timely resolution of their concerns.


* **Key Steps:**


* Clearly define escalation levels, including contact points and



response timelines.


* Share the escalation matrix during town hall / open house



sessions, onboarding programs, and via email/internal



communication channels.


* Display the escalation matrix at prominent locations within each



site for easy accessibility.



3\. **Payroll Processing:**


**Objective:** Ensure payroll is processed without any error.


* Ensure all necessary mappings are completed correctly before payroll processing.


* Ensure all inputs and drafts are shared on time.



 Process Full and Final Settlements (FNF) and gratuity payments on time. Employee salary grievances need to be addressed within the timeline.



4\. **Fortnightly Collaboration Calls with Ops team:**


**Objective**: Foster effective communication and resolve issues promptly.


**Participants:** Assignment Managers, Operations Officers, and Operations Managers.


**Frequency:** Conduct bi\-weekly calls with site stakeholders.


**Agenda:**



\- Discuss site\-level challenges, employee concerns, and operational bottlenecks. \- Share updates on HR initiatives, compliance requirements, and ongoing projects.


* Create and track action plans for unresolved issues.


**Documentation:**



\- Maintain a record of discussions, issues highlighted, and resolution timelines. \- Share minutes of the meeting (MoM) with all relevant stakeholders.



5\. **Monthly Meetings with New Employees (Guiding and Supporting New Employees (Direct and Indirect))**


* Organize casual monthly meetings for all new hires to share their experiences, challenges, and successes. This will encourage open communication and help us to get timely feedback.


* This involves providing comprehensive support to new employees, both direct and indirect, to help them transition smoothly into their roles and the organization. It includes offering guidance throughout the onboarding process, ensuring that new hires are familiar with company policies, culture, and expectations. Additionally, it involves addressing any questions or concerns they may have, facilitating their integration into teams, and providing ongoing assistance to ensure they feel welcomed, supported, and equipped to succeed in their new roles.


**6\. Attrition Management (Direct and Indirect)**



Attrition management refers to the strategies and processes implemented to reduce employee turnover and retain talent, focusing on both direct and indirect staff. This involves identifying the underlying causes of attrition, such as job dissatisfaction, lack of career growth, or personal challenges, and addressing them proactively.



For Indirect employees, attrition management includes providing career development opportunities, fostering a positive work culture, and



responding to their needs.



For direct staff, attrition management involves ensuring job security, creating clear communication channels, offering training opportunities, and implementing retention initiatives tailored to their specific concerns.



Effective attrition management for both groups is essential for



maintaining a stable workforce, improving employee satisfaction, and minimizing the costs associated with recruitment and training new employees.



 7\. **Compliance Management**


* Ensure all compliance requirements are met for your assigned cluster, including maintaining up\-to\-date licenses and certifications.


* Ensure the audit scores 100%, address any discrepancies or areas of improvement.


* Track and report compliance status regularly, ensuring timely resolution of any non\-compliance issues.


* Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure adherence to local, regional, and industry\-specific regulations.

title: HRIS Manager
description:
OVERVIEW:


The HRIS Manager sits within the Human Resources department and works closely with the IT, Payroll, and Finance/Accounting departments on a regular basis. He/she is responsible for overseeing the company’s HRIS. As an integral part of the Human Resources department, the HRIS Manager provides comprehensive administration of the HRIS that support HR data, onboarding, and training. This position is responsible for HR related data, companywide metrics and reports, and ensuring all systems are running without issues.


DESCRIPTION:

* Regularly audit all information saved in HRIS to ensure data accuracy, including but not limited to employee data, salaries, paid time off policies, FLSA exemptions, business processes and active integrations.
* Run regular and ad\-hoc reports of headcount/turnover, HR, benefits, payroll and compensation information
* Compile compensation reports of employee salaries to assist with developing a budget for annual increases and audit compensation information on a regular basis
* Troubleshoot systems and ensure that data is accurately captured across each system
* Troubleshoot HRIS issues and errors, quickly resolving them with root causes
* Research and resolve integration issues between the HRIS and other platforms as necessary. Ensuring that all system data feeds are accurate, operational and meet the business needs of the company
* Train users on how to use systems and provide global technical support
* Research and evaluate new systems based on requirements that the company can utilize. Review costs and benefits of introducing new systems.
* Implement new systems that are acquired and provide maintenance
* Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for your role and assigned by your manager/supervisor
* Managing and supporting the junior HRIS team members.

title: Senior Specialist, HR Services
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Specialist, HR Services
Job title: Senior Specialist, HR Services (Benefits)  

  

Overview  

People Services is part of Mastercard’s Global Business Services Center (GBSC) HR shared service organization and is responsible for supporting employees and HR teams by delivering consistent, accurate, and timely HR services globally. The team operates across multiple locations to provide high\-quality service aligned with regional time zones and business needs.  

The Senior Specialist, HR Services (Benefits) role provides advanced Tier 2 administrative and operational support for Europe Benefits programs, ensuring accurate benefits administration, strong vendor management, compliance with regulatory and internal control requirements, and audit readiness across multiple countries.  

This role goes beyond day\-to\-day administration and plays a key role in stabilizing operations, strengthening controls, supporting audits, and driving continuous improvement within the Europe Benefits function. The Senior Specialist acts as a subject matter expert for Europe Benefits processes, supports complex cases and escalations, and contributes to projects, transitions, and operational enhancements.  

The role is based in Pune, India and supports employees and stakeholders across the Europe region, partnering closely with HR Field, COEs, Payroll, HRIS, vendors, and the Europe Benefits team.  

Support includes managing complex benefits\-related inquiries, maintaining accurate employee and vendor data, supporting audits and compliance activities, coordinating with external providers, and ensuring operational excellence through strong attention to detail, documentation, governance, and accountability.  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  

Is This You?  

* Have you supported HR operations or benefits administration in a shared services or global environment, with exposure to complex or multi\-country processes?
* Do you enjoy owning end\-to\-end administrative processes and acting as a go\-to person for accuracy and compliance?
* Are you comfortable handling complex cases, escalations, audits, and vendor interactions?
* Do you have a strong customer service mindset combined with operational discipline and sound judgment?
* Are you motivated by stability, controls, documentation, and continuous improvement?
* Do you take pride in meeting service levels while maintaining quality, accuracy, and confidentiality?
* Do you enjoy working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment while continuously improving how work gets done?


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  

Role Responsibilities  

* Serve as a Senior Tier 2 support resource for Europe Benefits, professionally and accurately responding to complex employee inquiries and escalations received via Ask People Services (Workday Help), ensuring timely, compliant, and high\-quality resolution.
* Perform and oversee day\-to\-day benefits administration activities for Europe, including data validation, eligibility updates, lifecycle events, and coordination with benefits vendors and brokers.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Europe Benefits administration processes, policies, and country\-specific requirements, providing guidance and support to peers as needed.
* Partner closely with external benefits vendors and insurance brokers to ensure effective service delivery, issue resolution, and adherence to contractual and service level commitments.
* Validate vendor invoices, billing files, and reconciliations against contractual terms, employee census data, and internal controls; support payment processing and variance analysis.
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance by maintaining accurate documentation, evidence, approvals, and transaction records in line with Mastercard policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support and contribute to benefits\-related projects and cyclical activities, including Open Enrollment, renewals, data reviews, compliance checks, bonus sacrifice programs, and country\-specific initiatives.
* Monitor and ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and operational metrics; proactively identify risks, gaps, or recurring issues.
* Partner with internal stakeholders (HR Field, COEs, Payroll, HRIS, Finance, and GBSC teams) to gather information, resolve issues, and ensure accurate and timely execution of benefits processes.
* Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and process breakdowns; contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and employee experience.
* Maintain, create, and regularly update the Europe Benefits Knowledge Base and Desktop Procedures (DTPs), ensuring documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with policy, system, and operational changes.
* Support knowledge sharing and capability building within the team by contributing to training materials, process walk\-throughs, and transition support.
* Handle sensitive and confidential employee data with the highest level of integrity, in accordance with Mastercard confidentiality standards and data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR).
* Support the consistent, compliant, and standardized delivery of HR services across multiple countries within the Europe region.


\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  

All About You  

* Highly organized, detail\-oriented professional with a strong administrative and control mindset
* Demonstrated experience in HR operations, benefits administration, or shared services in a global or regional environment
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, exercising sound judgment within defined policies and controls
* Strong attention to detail with a proven track record of accuracy, compliance, and follow\-through
* Comfortable handling complex cases, audits, reconciliations, and vendor interactions
* Strong customer service orientation with a professional, empathetic, and solution\-focused approach
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high\-volume, time\-sensitive environment
* Collaborative and team\-oriented, with experience working across regions, cultures, and functions
* Professional demeanour with strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in English (written and spoken)
* Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills
* Comfortable operating within governance, controls, and compliance frameworks
* Results\-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook); strong Excel skills are a plus
* Workday experience is a plus

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
HRMS Principal Analyst
Your potential has a place here with TTEC’s award\-winning employment experience. As a Systems Software Principal Engineer working onsite in Hyderabad, India you’ll be a part of bringing humanity to business. \#experienceTTEC  

  

Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in India says it all!


**Job Title**


**Senior Taleo Consultant / Senior Taleo Specialist**


**Job Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **Senior Taleo Resource** to lead the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep functional and technical expertise in Taleo modules, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable recruitment and talent management solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Taleo Configuration \& Support**


* Lead end\-to\-end implementation, configuration, and optimization of Oracle Taleo modules, including:
* Taleo Recruiting (OTAC)
* Career Sections (internal and external)
* Taleo Connect Client (TCC)
* Provide advanced production support, troubleshooting complex issues related to workflows, requisitions, offers, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and feature rollouts.

**Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, and IT stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements.
* Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR leadership on Taleo best practices and system capabilities.

**Integrations \& Data Management**


* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and other HR systems (e.g., Oracle HCM, Workday, SAP, payroll, background check vendors).
* Utilize Taleo Connect Client (TCC), web services, and data loads for inbound and outbound integrations.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with organizational policies.

**Reporting \& Analytics**


* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards.
* Support ad\-hoc reporting needs for recruiting metrics, compliance, and executive insights.
* Assist in optimizing recruiting KPIs and analytics.

**Leadership \& Mentoring**


* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior Taleo resources and HR system analysts.
* Lead small to mid\-sized Taleo projects and enhancement initiatives.
* Contribute to process documentation, training materials, and knowledge transfer sessions.

**Required Qualifications**


**Experience**


* 6–10\+ years of experience working with Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven experience in at least one full Taleo implementation and multiple enhancement/support engagements.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Taleo Recruiting configuration and TCC integrations.

**Technical \& Functional Skills**


* Deep understanding of Taleo Recruiting workflows, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* Hands\-on expertise with:
* Taleo Connect Client (TCC)
* XML, CSV, and data integrations
* Web services and APIs
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capabilities within Taleo.

**Soft Skills**


* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Oracle Taleo certification(s).
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud integrations.
* Exposure to global recruiting processes and compliance requirements (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP).
* Prior experience in large enterprise or global HR environments.

**Education**


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).




**What You Can Expect**


* Supportive of your career and professional development


* An inclusive culture and community minded organization where giving back is encouraged


* A global team of curious lifelong learners guided by our company values


* Ask us about our paid time off (PTO) and wellness and healthcare benefits

Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. title: Bliv vores nye nøglespiller i et stærkt HR-team
description:
**Bliv vores nye nøglespiller i et stærkt HR\-team**
====================================================


***Er du en erfaren HR\-jurist, der skaber overblik og tryghed i komplekse personalesager*** ***og har modet til at udfordre, når det tjener organisationens bedste******? Motiveres du af at kunne gøre en forskel*** ***og*** ***lykkes med opgaverne i kraft af et stærkt team og høj faglighed?***  

  

**Samspillet med andre er din styrke**  

I HR\-afdelingen søger vi en faglig stærk holdspiller til vores Team Personalejura og Forhandling, der drives af at understøtte og yde god professionel personalejuridisk sparring, og samtidig har lyst til at indgå i en afdeling med et godt kollegaskab, psykologisk tryghed og et godt arbejdsmiljø. Vores vision er at sætte aftryk og gå forrest i samarbejdet. Vi har fokus på ordentlighed, og vi arbejder for at skabe en stærk organisation, som kan mere med os som samarbejdspartner.  

  

**Om jobbet – sparring, rådgivning og udvikling**  

I HR\-afdelingen er vi 15 topmotiverede og fagligt kompetente HR\-konsulenter. Som kolleger har vi en uformel omgangstone, og vi deler gerne både viden og vitser. Vi har mange spændende opgaver i teamet, som består af:  

* Personalejuridisk rådgivning i personalesager, herunder sagsbehandling, deltagelse i afskedigelsessager, udarbejdelse af skriftlige dokumenter samt forhandling.
* Fortolkning af og vejledning om overenskomstforhold, aftaler mv.
* Vejledning om løn som et strategisk ledelsesværktøj, herunder forhandling af lokalaftaler, forhåndsaftaler, konkret lønindplacering og lønforhandling.
* Udarbejdelse af ledelsesværktøjer, vejledninger, skabeloner mv. samt undervisning på området.

  

Du får herudover chancen for at undervise og dele din viden med både kollegaer og organisationen.  

  

**Hvordan ser det ud, når du arbejder hos os**  

Vi lover et job fyldt med udvikling og adgang til at prøve kræfter med store dele af ansættelsesretten, hvor du får lov at bringe både din faglige tyngde og dine kommunikative evner i spil. Vi garanterer dig, at ikke to dage er ens! Derfor prioriterer vi også ledelse tæt på, og tilbyder løbende sparring og feedback. Du kan desuden glæde dig til adgang til attraktive personalegoder – som en solid pensionsordning, god kantine, frugtordning, feriehuse i hele Danmark, medarbejderbehandling med fysioterapi, gratis fitness og spændende medarbejderforeninger.  

  

**Hvem bliver dine kollegaer**  

HR\-afdelingen består af to teams. Teamet, du bliver en del af, beskæftiger sig med personalejura, sygefravær og forhandling. Det andet team arbejder med organisations\- og lederudvikling, trivsel, arbejdsmiljø, rekruttering og MED\-system. HR\-afdelingen er i gang med en spændende udvikling og vi ser frem til at få dig med på holdet.  

  

**Sådan lykkes du i stillingen som HR\-konsulent**  

Du er dygtig og har gode sociale kompetencer og ved qua din erfaring, hvordan du finder vej til holdbare og smidige løsninger. Desuden kan du begå dig på alle niveauer i organisationen, og du er du ambitiøs på organisationens vegne. Du følger opgaverne til dørs og vægter ligesom os gensidig tillid og fleksibilitet højt.  

  

Herudover er du:  

* Uddannet Cand. Jur. eller har anden tilsvarende relevant uddannelse
* Har stor organisations\- og situationsforståelse samt gode formidlingsevner
* Undersøgende og nysgerrig på at finde løsninger i samspil med både stærke ledere og kolleger på tværs af organisationen
* Har blik for detaljen og formår at balancere mellem forskellige interesser, de formelle krav og forventningen om effektivitet
* Du videndeler gerne og sætter pris på samarbejdet med kolleger
* Trives med at levere service og høj kvalitet samt har forståelse for vores rolle som rådgiver i den offentlige sektor.

  

**Kontakt – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig**  

Har du spørgsmål til denne mulighed eller ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leder af Personalejura \& Forhandling Andrea Miller på tlf. 29248037 eller pr. mail på abm@horsens.dk.  

  

Arbejdstiden er fuld tid og løn\- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.  

  

**Ansøgningsfrist**  

Den 12\. april 2026 med start 1\. juni 2026\.  

  

Vi afholder 1\. samtalerunde den 15\. og 16\. april 2026 og 2\. samtalerunde den 23\. og 24\. april 2026\.  

  

Du kan læse mere om os og opgaverne i vores HR\-Håndbog.  

  

*I Horsens Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke, og vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, etnisk tilhørsforhold og handicap.*

title: Senior Manager - International Recruitment
description:
**Site Name:** Bengaluru Luxor North Tower  

**Posted Date:** Apr 7 2026 **Job Purpose**


You will lead international talent acquisition for GSK from India. You will design and deliver recruitment strategies that attract high\-quality candidates across commercial, supply chain, and global support roles. You will work in a global matrix and partner closely with hiring managers, HR leaders, and external partners. We value data\-led thinking, clear communication, and a coaching mindset. You will grow professionally while helping GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

  

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for international roles, including sourcing, assessment, selection, offer and onboarding.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and hard\-to\-fill roles using market mapping and proactive sourcing.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR business partners to design role profiles, selection processes and hiring decisions.
* Manage relationships with external vendors, RPO partners and executive search firms to ensure consistent delivery.
* Use recruitment metrics and market insights to improve candidate quality, reduce time to fill and enhance candidate experience.
* Coach and mentor recruiters and sourcers, fostering capability building and continuous improvement.

**Why You?**  

  

**Basic Qualification**  

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years of end\-to\-end recruitment experience, including international hiring exposure.
* Experience working in a matrixed global environment and partnering with senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage vendor or RPO relationships.  

Strong stakeholder management and consultative influencing skills.
* Proficiency with ATS tools and common office software.

**Preferred Qualification**  

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus

* Master’s degree in HR, Business or related field.
* Experience recruiting for commercial, supply chain, or global support functions in pharma, life sciences or FMCG.
* Experience leading a team of recruiters or managing recruitment programs.
* Hands\-on experience with recruitment marketing or employer branding campaigns.
* Strong data literacy with experience using recruitment metrics to drive decisions.
* Experience in leadership or executive search and negotiation of offers.

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**


GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.


People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**


As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.


Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**


GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.


It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**


If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Procurement Manager, Contracts
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do

* Partner with the Enterprise Procurement \& Payables (EP\&P) team and global stakeholders to draft, review, and negotiate moderately complex commercial contracts, ensuring alignment with BCG contracting standards.
* Lead contract renewals and lifecycle management activities, maintaining appropriate contractual coverage and securing best\-in\-class commercial terms.
* Provide contract management support across Corporate Services / HR categories, acting as a key interface between procurement and business stakeholders.
* Proactively manage the expiring contracts pipeline, reviewing contract expiry reports and coordinating renewal strategies with relevant stakeholders.
* Conduct spend investigations and analysis to support sourcing initiatives, supplier management, and stakeholder inquiries.
* Track and report savings delivery, monitoring progress against agreed targets and ensuring stakeholder validation and formal sign\-off of realized benefits.
* Serve as the first point of contact for ad hoc contract and supplier\-related requests from the business.
* Collaborate with key control groups, including Legal, Information Security, and Group Insurance, to ensure appropriate reviews are completed and agreements meet BCG legal and compliance standards prior to execution.
* Maintain accurate contract records within the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system, ensuring metadata integrity and leveraging CLM reporting to track renewals and support contract governance.

  

What You'll Bring

* BA/BS degree in relevant field
* Knowledge of procurement and sourcing, with at least 5 years’ experience in a related position within a global organization or professional services company; with 2\-5 years of Facilities or HR related experience.
* Proven track record of drafting and negotiating agreements and leading contract negotiations with suppliers, both new and renewals
* Execution oriented management of a portfolio of agreements
* Experience formulating clear and concise communications orally and written (in email and PowerPoint) working directly with stakeholders of varying levels of seniority

  

Who You'll Work With


BCG spends \~$2\.4B on goods and services across the firm globally. At its core, Procurement is accountable for ensuring that BCG is supplied with goods and services that meet business requirements, drive value and best whole life cost to BCG.
  

  

EP\&P is currently made up of \~150 procurement professionals located in London, New Delhi, Boston and Munich. It has embarked upon a transformation program to define and implement strategies, organization, systems and policies to create a sustainable operating model. This model should maximize value from our suppliers, mitigate risk and meet savings targets. BCG is a highly matrixed firm where purchasing decisions are often taken at the local level, therefore this transformation will need to be carried out with high levels of stakeholder engagement, alignment and collaboration.
  

  

Scope of work will be global, regional as well as local, requiring procurement experience, relationship building, sell\-in capabilities and sensitivity to local requirements. The individual taking on this challenge must possess a very high level of self\-motivation/drive, persistency, resourcefulness and a willingness to facilitate change

  

Additional info


YOU’RE GOOD AT  

* Proven negotiation skills, a record of accomplishment in structuring progressive vendor arrangements across a variety of vendor types and also contracting experience
* High level of intellectual agility, initiative, self\-motivation, tenacity, and the ability to negotiate and bring together different audiences
* Excellent analytical skills, and a high skill\-set in Excel and PowerPoint is considered a pre\-requisite for the role
* Ability to independently resolve complex issues/problems, but seeks advice and counsel for decisions including key stakeholders where appropriate
* Focus on industry and market best practices
* Strong influencing skills and ability to get stakeholder buy\-in for initiatives and projects
* Demonstrates advanced communication skills: oral, written and active listening
  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

 India is going through a major shift in how companies build and manage talent. Startups today are not just growing fast—they are redefining workplace culture, employee experience, and people practices.

* Culture Integration: Ensure the department’s sub\-culture aligns with the overall organizational values, driving initiatives that boost morale and belonging.
* Strategic Business Partnership

**Required Qualifications**
* MBA / PG in Human Resource Management (mandatory)

* Strong leadership potential, excellent communication skills, and a high degree of empathy mixed with professional firmness.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong communication (written and verbal)
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality
* Good understanding of workplace culture and employee behavior
* Comfortable working with HR tools and systems, automation.
* Ability to take ownership and work independently


 What Separates the Best from the Rest
   

  

* Proactive mindset – you don’t wait, you act
* Ability to suggest and implement new ideas for engagement and retention
* Strong problem\-solving approach in handling employee concerns
* High ownership and accountability in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Ability to understand challenges early and act on them

 Coordinate with hospitality institutes and placement cells for a steady pipeline of entry\-level and trained talent.
 




  





**2\. Payroll \& Attendance  —  Priority** 




**•** 

 Process monthly payroll accurately and on time for all employees across Centro, Chirp, and Bloom using HRMS and Excel.
 




**•** 

 Maintain daily attendance records, track leave balances, overtime, and any anomalies across all outlets.
 




**•** 

 Update payroll inputs for new joiners, exits, promotions, and increments on a rolling basis.
 




**•** 

 Coordinate with Finance to resolve discrepancies and ensure salary disbursements are compliant and on schedule.
 




**•** 

 Manage statutory deductions — PF, ESIC, Professional Tax — and ensure timely remittance and filing.
 




**•** 

 Generate monthly payroll summaries and attendance reports for the HR Manager and founders.
 




  





**3\. Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle** 




**•** 

 Coordinate the full onboarding process for every new hire: documentation collection, system setup, orientation scheduling, and role introduction.
 




**•** 

 Conduct brand\-oriented induction sessions that give new employees a clear sense of who SARC is, what we stand for, and how each brand connects.
 




**•** 

 Maintain complete and accurate employee files from day one through exit.
 




**•** 

 Manage exit formalities with care: resignation processing, handover coordination, F\&F settlement support, and exit interviews.
 




**•** 

 Track patterns in exit feedback and share summarised insights with the HR Manager quarterly.
 




  





**4\. Training \& Development** 




**•** 

 Assist the HR Manager in planning and scheduling internal training — both operational (SOPs, service standards) and soft skills (communication, guest handling, team conduct).
 




**•** 

 Maintain a training calendar and track completion across departments.
 




**•** 

 Coordinate with department heads to identify gaps and prioritise training needs.
 




**•** 

 Maintain training records and post\-training feedback, and flag where programmes need revision.
 




  





**5\. Employee Engagement \& Welfare** 




**•** 

 Be accessible and approachable — the first port of call for employees with questions, concerns, or grievances.
 




**•** 

 Handle employee concerns with empathy and discretion; escalate appropriately when issues require HR Manager or founder involvement.
 




**•** 

 Coordinate engagement initiatives: birthday and work anniversary acknowledgements, team events, recognition moments, and internal surveys.
 




**•** 

 Support the HR Manager in designing and running larger engagement programmes that reinforce SARC's culture.
 




**•** 

 Uphold a respectful, inclusive, and psychologically safe workplace across all brands and teams.
 




  





**6\. Compliance \& Record Management** 




**•** 

 Maintain updated, complete, and confidential employee records — contracts, ID verification, offer letters, appraisal documents, and statutory forms.
 




**•** 

 Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws: Shops \& Establishments Act, PF \& ESIC regulations, Minimum Wages Act, Gratuity Act, and POSH.
 




**•** 

 Assist in preparing HR reports and documentation for compliance audits.
 




**•** 

 Support the HR Manager in maintaining and updating HR SOPs, policy documents, and the employee handbook.
 




**•** 

 Coordinate POSH\-related awareness sessions and ensure committee requirements are met.
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 




**•** 

 2–4 years of HR experience, with at least 1 year in a hospitality or service\-sector environment.
 




**•** 

 Proven, hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment — not just coordination, but actual sourcing and screening ownership.
 




**•** 

 Working knowledge of payroll processing and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS).
 




**•** 

 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (attendance tracking, payroll sheets, basic formulas) and at least one HRMS/payroll tool — Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar.
 




**•** 

 Strong working knowledge of applicable Indian labour laws.
 




**•** 

 Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or equivalent.
 




**•** 

 Based in Pune and available for in\-person work from Day 1\.
 




  





**Strong Advantage** 




**•** 

 Experience in a multi\-outlet or multi\-brand hospitality setup.
 




**•** 

 Familiarity with employer branding and job portal management (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed).
 




**•** 

 Exposure to onboarding design, training coordination, or engagement programme execution.
 




**•** 

 PGDM or MBA in HRM.
 




  





**Who You Are** 




**•** 

 You are reliable — deadlines don’t slip on your watch, especially payroll.
 




**•** 

 You handle confidential information with discretion, always.
 




**•** 

 You are warm and approachable without being a pushover — you can hold a firm line when the policy calls for it.
 




**•** 

 You are comfortable in a fast\-moving, startup\-style environment where priorities can shift and flexibility is a daily requirement.
 




**•** 

 You have high attention to detail — in a spreadsheet and in a conversation.
 




**•** 

 You genuinely care about the people you work with and see HR as a function that creates value, not just enforces rules.
 




  





**What We Offer** 




**•** 

 Competitive salary in line with Pune hospitality industry benchmarks.
 




**•** 

 A defined growth path: this role is built to evolve into an HR Manager position as SARC scales.
 




**•** 

 Direct exposure to all facets of hospitality HR across three distinct brand environments.
 




**•** 

 Opportunity to work closely with the founders and contribute to building the people function from the ground up.
 




**•** 

 Employee benefits: dining privileges at Chirp, access to events at Bloom.
 




**•** 

 Statutory benefits: Provident Fund, paid sick leave, paid time off.
 




**•** 

 A team culture that values ownership, initiative, and genuine care for people.
 




  





**A Note on Working at SARC** 





 SARC is fast\-moving, founder\-led, and holds itself to a high bar across every guest touchpoint. That energy runs through the team too. You will be expected to own your function, flag issues early, and solve problems without waiting to be asked.
 




  




* We are building something we’re genuinely proud of in Pune hospitality — and the people who join us now will have a real hand in shaping what it becomes. If that sounds like the kind of environment you do your best work in, we want to hear from you.

description:

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Assistant Manager – Employee Relations**
**Function Description:**
 Employee Relations function is a Centre of Excellence function within the Talent organisation of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS). Employee Relations CoE works in close partnership with Strategic Talent Consultant function, GDS Ethics Office as well as GDS General Counsel’s Office and is primarily responsible for managing complex/sensitive ER incidents. The function continuously monitors the ER risk profile of the Firm and develop/deploy strategies to manage the same. ER CoE is also responsible to project manage Talent special projects and is the custodian of all Talent Policies.
   

  

**Job description:**
* Conduct workplace investigations into sensitive Employee Relations matters. This involves facilitating and documenting Investigation interviews, analysing evidence and drafting investigation findings reports.
* Partner with Senior ER professionals in providing guidance to Talent Consultants and Business Leaders in managing wide range of Employee Relation issues, including Code of conduct breaches, Performance lapses, Discrimination allegations, Workplace harassment allegations, Integrity issues etc, and ensure resolution of the same with minimal risk exposure to the Firm and its professionals.
* Maintain ER Incident data base, identify trends and thereby assist Talent leadership in developing appropriate strategies and initiatives to proactively mitigate ER risk exposures.
* Actively participate in special projects undertaken by EY GDS Employee Relations Centre of Excellence


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* Education : Master’s Degree in Human Resource Management or Business Administration with HR specialisation or Bachelor in Legislative Law (LLB)
* Experience : 6 \- 10 years of experience of Human Resources, with at least 4 years experience in Employment Law, preferably in Big Fours or Leading IT services/Consulting Firms.
* Should have strong knowledge of Indian employment law and regulations, especially related to conduct of disciplinary procedures, work\-place investigations, employment litigation procedures etc
* Should possess exceptional written skills, specifically legal writing, as well as oral communication skills.
* Should have the capability to apply discretion and make sound judgement, even in highly stressful and emotional scenarios.
* Should have the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
* Should be able to navigate through complex, difficult, and ambiguous situations.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, Mexico, Philippines, Poland, Spain and Sri Lanka – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
